newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Systems in pact with AOL site.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Systems in pact with AOL site.

text.p: Banyan Systems Inc on Wednesday said that its Switchboard Internet directory will be the official directory for Digital City Inc 's network of forums on America Online.
In addition, Digital City, jointly owned by America Online and the Tribune Co, will be the exclusive sales channel for local display advertisements for Switchboard's "yellow pages," Banyan said.
Banyan System shares rose $1-1/4 per share to $5-1/4 by late Wednesday afternoon, up 31.25 percent from Tuesday.
Digital City and America Online will promote Switchboard as their premier directories from January 1997.
The terms of the pact were not disclosed.
Swithboard is a directory, found on the Internet, that includes e-mail and World Wide Web page addresses along side conventional telephone numbers and physical address data.

Digital City's network provides online services to 13 U.S. cities, with additional cities planned for 1997, the company said. The addition of Switchboard will allow Digital City to offer local merchants to pinpoint advertising to a specific category and city that a consumer is searching in Switchboard.
The companies also announced that Digital City and AOL have made a minority equity investment in Switchboard Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Banyan.
This move follows last month's agreement by AOL to integrate Switchboard into its system.
